Name: Mighty Nein in Stardew Valley
Author: calicoJill
Description:
This content patch will replace NPC's with members of the Mighty Nein. The list includes
Fjord (Alex overhaul)
Beau (Abigail overhaul)
Caleb (Shane overhaul)
Nott (Jas overhaul)
Jester (Emily overhaul)
Molly (Sebastian overhaul)
Caduceus (Elliott overhaul)
Yasha (Leah overhaul)

It changes, portraits, sprites, dialogue, likes, events and even some quests to be more character specific to the Mighty Nein.

It also includes additional hairstyles and an altered skin colour file to allow you to make a member of the Mighty Nein as your player character.

NOTE: If you choose to play as a member of the Mighty Nein, you may need to set the hair option to white in order for it to display properly as I had to colour the hair texture in order to give it variation. IE: Blue ribbon in Beau's brown hair, Nott's mask along with her ears, Gold and silver on Molly's horns.
Also be aware that in playing as a member of the Mighty Nein you will have a twin in town somewhere as I wasn't about to make 8 variations of the same mod seeing as changing one character isn't as simple as replacing a name, sprite and portrait. It involves editing dozens of events and dialogues and assets in order to catch any discrepancies. 

New likes for characters include
Fjord - things with tentacles, beer, ale
Beau - alcohols
Caleb - peppers, fire quartz, basically things that are hot. (unfortunately you can't give him books or cats)
Nott- alcohol and explosives, shiny things
Jester - Sweets, milk, and rubies
Molly- alcohol, and egg dishes
Caduceus - foraged things, mushrooms
Yasha - alcohol, flowers

Note this is a bit of a work in progress as there were a million things to edit and I'm sure I haven't caught everything. There will most likely still be small spelling errors or a missed name here and there that I didn't catch, but if you find anything that sticks out as odd, please let me know so I can fix it for a future update.
